svg.title: phageFACTor scoring, compare and curate detail
svg.text: how a pile of FoldSeek hits becomes one curated call per gene — gates, filters, confidence tiers, rule tree
e = e-value · score = FoldSeek bitscore · superscripts ¹–²¹ → see phageFACTor_code_lists.md (exact file + line of each list/pattern)
STEP 02 · FoldSeek scoring → best_hit / top3 (lib/foldseek_scoring.py · all lists: lib/lexicon.py)
CONFIDENT e≤1e-3 & score≥200 · GOOD e≤0.01 / score≥200
BORDERLINE e≤0.1 / score≥90 · WEAK else · NO_HIT no hit
CONFIDENT tightened: score-only route removed; promiscuous folds capped at BORDERLINE. WEAK/NO_HIT excluded downstream.
Both search modes (02d local · 02w webAPI, experimental: needs ESMFold) feed this SAME path — best_hit.csv / top3.csv are identical in shape regardless of where the search ran.
Promiscuous folds (β-lactamase/MBL, motor proteins, RHH) and eukaryotic-only hits are flagged here, not deleted — step 03/04 route them to review.
agreement labels (Jaccard on descriptions + category map ⁹):
Output: comparison_per_gene.csv — one row/gene with phold call, FoldSeek call, sub-DB name, flags, confidence and agreement side by side.
STEP 04 · curate — ordered rule tree → final call or review (04_curate_annotations.py)
rules are tried top→bottom; first match wins. auto_* = confident enough to annotate silently; needs_review_* = surfaced in review_suggested.csv
structured VFDB/CARD/ACR/NetFlaX/DF name beats a generic FS homolog ¹⁴
FS below GOOD or generic/gp ¹⁵ → keep informative phold, no review
CONF/GOOD & phage-relevant (boost≥1.5 / same_host / defense ¹⁶) beats weak phold
ta-functionalize · transposition-motor · euka→bacterial homolog ¹¹ · domain ¹⁰
β-lactamase/MBL, motor, RHH ⁵: noted but never auto-annotated
demoted euka best hit, no prokaryotic/viral support (rescue ¹³, prefilter ¹²)
lone BORDERLINE hit, or phold≠FS with both informative
agreement pick + function category ¹⁷ + short_name ¹⁹
final_product · short_name ¹⁹ · category ¹⁷ · source · evidence
flagged genes with the reason, for manual curation
Host boost (×1.2) applies when hit taxonomy
